name: Fraud Block — Faster Payment Initiation (Exception Path EX-002)
description: PER-001 initiates a Faster Payment. CoP returns a no_match (customer overrides with explicit confirmation). Sanctions screen is clear. Fraud score exceeds the block threshold (e.g. new payee + no-match CoP + unusual amount). SVC-001 publishes PaymentFraudBlocked. Customer sees a generic decline. Fraud Analyst (PER-054) receives a case for investigation.

steps.action: Enter payee details (new payee, amount £2,500 — unusually large for this account history)
POST /cop/verify { payee_sort_code, payee_account_number, payee_name }
200 OK { cop_result: 'no_match', risk_warning_required: true }
Display PSR SD17 risk warning: 'Name does not match the account at the receiving bank. This could be a sign of fraud.' Show Confirm / Cancel buttons.
Customer clicks 'I understand the risk and want to proceed' (explicit override confirmation)
steps.note: Override timestamp and confirmation are recorded

steps.action: Complete SCA (biometric)
POST /sca/validate { assertion, payee_sort_code, payee_account_number, amount }
200 OK { sca_assertion_ref, valid: true }
POST /payments { account_id, amount: 2500.00, payee details, cop_result: no_match, cop_override_confirmed: true, cop_override_timestamp, sca_assertion_ref }
202 Accepted { payment_intent_id, status: pending_screening }
Publish PaymentIntentCreated (EVT-P01) — includes cop_result: no_match, cop_override_confirmed: true
Show 'Processing your payment...' screen
Run sanctions screen → outcome: clear
Run fraud scoring — features: new payee + no_match CoP override + large amount vs account history
steps.note: Concurrent with step 13. High fraud score generated.

steps.action: Publish SanctionsScreeningCompleted (EVT-P02) { outcome: clear }
Publish FraudScoreCompleted (EVT-P03) { risk_level: block, fraud_score: 0.94, top_risk_features: [cop_no_match_override, unusual_amount_vs_history, new_payee] }
Consume EVT-P02 (clear) and EVT-P03 (BLOCK). Decision: fraud block.
Publish PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-P08) — update PaymentIntent.status = fraud_blocked
Write EVT-P08 to WORM audit log (risk_level, top_risk_features recorded; raw fraud_score not in SVC-103 log)
Consume PaymentFraudBlocked → create fraud investigation case. Assign to PER-054 (Fraud Analyst).
Alert: New fraud block case — £2,500 payment to [payee]. risk_level: block. Top features: CoP no_match override, unusual amount.
GET /payments/{payment_intent_id} (polling)
200 OK { status: fraud_blocked, failure_reason: generic_decline }
steps.note: fraud_blocked status returned; failure_reason is generic_decline (fraud detail not disclosed to channel/customer)

steps.action: Display: 'We've blocked this payment for your security. If you authorised this payment, please call [fraud line]. No money has left your account.'
(Out of band) Review case: full fraud score, model features, account history, device metadata. Determine true positive vs false positive.

outcome: Payment blocked. Customer notified with generic message. Fraud Analyst investigates. If false positive, analyst may release — triggering PaymentCleared re-emission. If true positive, block confirmed and case closed.
app_fraud_note: The cop_override_confirmed: true on PaymentIntent is evidence for gross negligence assessment if customer later claims APP fraud reimbursement. Override alone is not automatic disqualification — PSR PS23/3 gross negligence standard applies.
